_about: Trust tiers used by tools/apply.mjs. A result is published only when confirmed: one Tier 1 source, OR two Tier 2 sources from different sites, OR one Tier 2 plus one Tier 3. Tier 3 never counts on its own. Matching is by site (sub-domains included). Sources must be independent: an article that credits a news agency (e.g. '— QNA', '(WAM)', 'قنا', 'وام', 'كونا') counts as that agency, so never list it next to the agency's own report as a second source.

tier1.uaeproleague.ae: UAE Pro League — official organiser of the ADNOC Pro League, ADIB Cup and EMAAR Super Cup
tier1.uaefa.ae: UAE Football Association — official organiser of the UAE President's Cup
tier1.the-afc.com: Asian Football Confederation — official (ACL Elite, ACL Two, Asian Cup)
tier1.agcff.org: Arab Gulf Cup Football Federation — official (Gulf Club Champions League)

tier2.skysports.com: Sky Sports — results, fixtures and tables for European football
tier2.site.api.espn.com: ESPN data feed (same data as espn.com)
tier2.wam.ae: WAM — Emirates News Agency (state news agency)
tier2.aletihad.ae: Al Ittihad (Abu Dhabi) incl. its English edition, which carries WAM reports
tier2.kuna.net.kw: KUNA — Kuwait News Agency (state news agency)
tier2.bna.bh: BNA — Bahrain News Agency (state news agency)
tier2.omannews.gov.om: ONA — Oman News Agency (state news agency)
tier2.ina.iq: INA — Iraqi News Agency (state news agency)

tier3.thesportsdb.com: TheSportsDB — community-maintained; good for fixture lists, cross-check only
tier3.rsssf.org: RSSSF — football statistics archive; reliable but updated after the fact
